details.label: Discussion
details.text: An isolated elevated supercell has recently intensified to the west-northwest of Aberdeen. In the short term, MUCAPE of around 2000 J/kg and sufficient deep-layer shear will continue to support a threat of hail and localized severe gusts with this cell. To the east, a longer-lived storm cluster is moving across northeast SD. While this cluster has shown some signs of weakening, localized strong/damaging gusts cannot be ruled out as this cluster approaches the SD/ND/MN border region. With time, decreasing MUCAPE and increasing CINH with eastward extent should tend to result in a general weakening trend overnight, though localized hail and gusty winds may continue until convection subsides
